AddIceCubes.description: Put the *two/three* ice cubes in the blender.
AddIceCubes.name: AddIceCubes

AddLemonToFish.description: Take the lemon from the fridge and place it on the plate with fish on the dining counter.
AddLemonToFish.name: AddLemonToFish

AddMarshmallow.description: Pick up the marshmallow and place it in the cup of hot chocolate on the dining counter.
AddMarshmallow.name: AddMarshmallow

AddSugarCubes.description: Take the two sugar cubes and place them on the plate with the cake.
AddSugarCubes.name: AddSugarCubes

AddSweetener.description: Put the *two/three* sugar cubes in the blender.
AddSweetener.name: AddSweetener

AddToSoupPot.description: Remove the lid from the simmering saucepan and add the [*vegetables*] from the plate to the saucepan. Then place the lid back to continue slow cooking the soup.
AddToSoupPot.name: AddToSoupPot

AdjustHeat.description: Put the [*vegetables*] in the pan. Then turn on the [*burner location*] burner and set the heat to medium.
AdjustHeat.name: AdjustHeat

AdjustWaterTemperature.description: The water running in the sink is {hot/cold}. Adjust the faucet handle to run the water {cold/hot}. Make sure to keep the water on.
AdjustWaterTemperature.name: AdjustWaterTemperature

AfterwashSorting.description: Pick the [*vegetable1*] from the sink and place them in one bowl. Place the [*vegetable2*] in the other bowl. Then turn off the sink faucet.
AfterwashSorting.name: AfterwashSorting

AirDryFruit.description: Pick the [*fruit*] from the sink and place it on the cutting board to airdry. Then turn off the sink faucet.
AirDryFruit.name: AirDryFruit

AlcoholServingPrep.description: Open the cabinet directly in front. Then move the [*alcohol*] and the [*cup*] to the dining counter with the [*decoration*] on it.
AlcoholServingPrep.name: AlcoholServingPrep

AlignSilverware.description: Take the fork and place it on the left side of the plate. Then take the spoon and place it on the right side of the plate. Make sure they're directly next to the plate.
AlignSilverware.name: AlignSilverware

ArrangeBreadBasket.description: Open the cabinet, pick up the [*bread*] from the cabinet and place it in the basket. Then move the basket to the dining counter.
ArrangeBreadBasket.name: ArrangeBreadBasket

ArrangeBreadBowl.description: Pick up the heated [*bread*] from the toaster oven and place it in the bowl. Then move the bread bowl to the dining counter.
ArrangeBreadBowl.name: ArrangeBreadBowl

ArrangeBuffetDessert.description: Take the [*sweets*] from the fridge and place them on the empty tray on the dining counter.
ArrangeBuffetDessert.name: ArrangeBuffetDessert

ArrangeCuttingFruits.description: Place the fruits in the fridge on the cutting board by the sink to make a fruit bowl. Leave the non-fruit items in the fridge.
ArrangeCuttingFruits.name: ArrangeCuttingFruits

ArrangeDrinkware.description: Place the pitcher and cup on the dining counter for serving.
ArrangeDrinkware.name: ArrangeDrinkware

ArrangeSinkSanitization.description: Place the sponge and dishbrush next to the sink on the counter.
ArrangeSinkSanitization.name: ArrangeSinkSanitization

ArrangeTea.description: Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on the tray. Then pick the mug from the cabinet and place it on the tray. Then close the cabinet doors.
ArrangeTea.name: ArrangeTea

ArrangeTeaAccompaniments.description: Take out the milk from the fridge and place it on the tray on the counter. Then take the sugar cube near the tray and place it in the tray.
ArrangeTeaAccompaniments.name: ArrangeTeaAccompaniments

ArrangeUtensilsByType.description: Organize the utensils by type. Pick up the wooden spoons from the counter and place them in the open cabinet. Then pick up the metallic utensils from the counter and place them in the open drawer.
ArrangeUtensilsByType.name: ArrangeUtensilsByType

ArrangeVegetables.description: Pick the vegetables from the sink and place them on the cutting board.
ArrangeVegetables.name: ArrangeVegetables

AssembleCookingArray.description: Move the [*meat*] onto the pan on the stove. Then move the [*condiment*] and [*vegetable*] from the cabinet to the counter where the plate is.
AssembleCookingArray.name: AssembleCookingArray

BalancedMealPrep.description: Place the [*meat*] on the plate and place the [*vegetable*] on the same plate.
BalancedMealPrep.name: BalancedMealPrep

BeginSlowCooking.description: Set the burner covering the saucepan with broth to low heat, and place the lid on the saucepan to begin slow cooking.
BeginSlowCooking.name: BeginSlowCooking

BeverageOrganization.description: Move the drinks to the dining counter.
BeverageOrganization.name: BeverageOrganization

BeverageSorting.description: Sort all alcoholic drinks to one cabinet, and non-alcoholic drinks to the other.
BeverageSorting.name: BeverageSorting

BlendIngredients.description: Open the blender lid, put the fruit in the blender, close the lid, and start the blender.
BlendIngredients.name: BlendIngredients

BlendMarinade.description: Grab the [*vegetables*] from the fridge, place them in the blender, close the lid, and turn on the blender to create a marinade.
BlendMarinade.name: BlendMarinade

BlendSalsaMix.description: Open the blender lid and place the tomato, chili pepper, and onion in the blender. Then place the lid back on and press the power button to make salsa.
BlendSalsaMix.name: BlendSalsaMix

BlendVegetableSauce.description: The [*vegetable*] is done being boiled. Turn off the stove burner for the saucepan. Place the [*vegetable*] in the blender and turn on the blender to make a vegetable sauce.
BlendVegetableSauce.name: BlendVegetableSauce

BoilCorn.description: Place both pieces of corn from the plate into the saucepan. Then place the lid on the saucepan to start boiling the corn.
BoilCorn.name: BoilCorn

BoilEggs.description: Place both eggs from the plate into the saucepan with boiling water.
BoilEggs.name: BoilEggs

BoilPot.description: Take the pot filled with water and place it on the stove. Then turn on the stove burner to begin boiling the water.
BoilPot.name: BoilPot

BowlAndCup.description: Place the cup inside the bowl on the dining table and move the bowl to any counter.
BowlAndCup.name: BowlAndCup

BreadAndCheese.description: Place the bread and cheese on the cutting board.
BreadAndCheese.name: BreadAndCheese

BreadSelection.description: From the different types of pastries on the counter, select a croissant and place it on the cutting board. Then retrieve a jar of jam from the cabinet and place it alongside the croissant on the cutting board.
BreadSelection.name: BreadSelection

BreadSetupSlicing.description: Place all breads on the cutting board.
BreadSetupSlicing.name: BreadSetupSlicing

BuildAppetizerPlate.description: Take the [*cheese*], [*meat*], and [*vegetable*] from the fridge and place them on the plate on the dining counter to create an appetizer plate.
BuildAppetizerPlate.name: BuildAppetizerPlate

ButterOnPan.description: Pick up the butter stick and place it in the pan. Then turn on the burner for the pan.
ButterOnPan.name: ButterOnPan

CandleCleanup.description: Pick the [*decorations*] from the dining table and place them in the open cabinet. Close the cabinet after placing the objects.
CandleCleanup.name: CandleCleanup

CategorizeCondiments.description: Put the shaker and condiment bottle from the counter next to their counterparts in the cabinet.
CategorizeCondiments.name: CategorizeCondiments

CerealAndBowl.description: Open the cabinet. Pick the cereal and bowl from the cabinet and place them on the counter next to the milk. Then close the cabinet.
CerealAndBowl.name: CerealAndBowl

CheeseMixing.description: Put the cheese in the pot filled with milk and stir.
CheeseMixing.name: CheeseMixing

CheesyBread.description: Pick up the wedge of cheese and place it on the slice of bread to prepare a simple cheese on bread dish.
CheesyBread.name: CheesyBread

ChooseMeasuringCup.description: Open the *left/right* drawer and place the *larger/smaller* measuring cup on the counter.
ChooseMeasuringCup.name: ChooseMeasuringCup

ChooseRipeFruit.description: Put the non-rotten fruit in the blender.
ChooseRipeFruit.name: ChooseRipeFruit

CleanBlenderJug.description: Take the blender jug and place it in the sink to prepare it for cleaning.
CleanBlenderJug.name: CleanBlenderJug

CleanBoard.description: Move the cutting board and knife to the sink. Then move spray from the cabinet to the counter.
CleanBoard.name: CleanBoard

CleanMicrowave.description: Place the sponge inside the microwave to prepare for sanitizing.
CleanMicrowave.name: CleanMicrowave

ClearClutter.description: Pick up all produce items and place them in the sink. Turn on the sink faucet to wash them. Then turn the sink off and put them in the tray.
ClearClutter.name: ClearClutter

ClearCuttingBoard.description: Clear the non-vegetable object off the cutting board and place the vegetables onto it.
ClearCuttingBoard.name: ClearCuttingBoard

ClearFoodWaste.description: Move the food items out of the sink and into the colander.
ClearFoodWaste.name: ClearFoodWaste

ClearFreezer.description: Take the [*food items*] from the freezer and place them in the bowl on the counter.
ClearFreezer.name: ClearFreezer

ClearReceptaclesForCleaning.description: Pick the [*tableware*] and place them in the sink. Then turn on the water.
ClearReceptaclesForCleaning.name: ClearReceptaclesForCleaning

ClearSink.description: Remove the [*food items*] from the sink. Then move the [*dishes*] from the counter to the sink for washing.
ClearSink.name: ClearSink

ClearSinkArea.description: Clear the mugs and bowl far away from the sink.
ClearSinkArea.name: ClearSinkArea

ClearSinkSpace.description: Pick the objects in the sink and place them on the counter to clear sink space for washing produce.
ClearSinkSpace.name: ClearSinkSpace

CloseBlenderLid.description: Close the lid blender by securely placing the lid on top.
CloseBlenderLid.name: CloseBlenderLid

CloseElectricKettleLid.description: Close the lid of the electric kettle.
CloseElectricKettleLid.name: CloseElectricKettleLid

ClusterItemsForClearing.description: Move the [*tableware1*] to cluster with the [*tableware2*] on the dining counter for efficient clearing.
ClusterItemsForClearing.name: ClusterItemsForClearing

ClusterUtensilsInDrawer.description: Pick up the fork from the counter and place it on the *left/right* side of the drawer. Then, pick up the spoon from the counter and place it on the *right/left* side of the drawer. Make sure that the utensils are clustered by type.
ClusterUtensilsInDrawer.name: ClusterUtensilsInDrawer

CoffeeServeMug.description: Pick the mug from under the coffee machine dispenser and place it on the counter.
CoffeeServeMug.name: CoffeeServeMug

CoffeeSetupMug.description: Pick the mug from the counter and place it under the coffee machine dispenser.
CoffeeSetupMug.name: CoffeeSetupMug

CollectWashingSupplies.description: Locate and retrieve the [*cleaning items*] from the cabinet. Place them next to the sink.
CollectWashingSupplies.name: CollectWashingSupplies

ColorfulSalsa.description: Place the avocado, onion, tomato, and bell pepper on the cutting board.
ColorfulSalsa.name: ColorfulSalsa

CondimentCollection.description: Pick the [*condiments*] from the counter and place them in the cabinet.
CondimentCollection.name: CondimentCollection

CookieDoughPrep.description: Pick the egg and butter from the fridge and place them by the bowl for mixing.
CookieDoughPrep.name: CookieDoughPrep

CoolBakedCake.description: Take the baked cake out of the oven and place it on the plate for cooling. Then close the oven door.
CoolBakedCake.name: CoolBakedCake

CoolBakedCookies.description: Open the oven door and slide the top rack out. Then take the tray with baked cookies out of the oven and place it on the counter for cooling.
CoolBakedCookies.name: CoolBakedCookies

CoolKettle.description: The kettle is done boiling. Turn off the stove, then wait for 300 timesteps before moving the kettle to the dining table.
CoolKettle.name: CoolKettle

CountertopCleanup.description: Clean up the countertop by placing items away. Place the [*utensil*] in the open drawer. Place the [*tableware*] in the open cabinet. Place the bowl with the [*food*] in the fridge.
CountertopCleanup.name: CountertopCleanup

CreateChildFriendlyFridge.description: Place the alcohol on the top shelf of the fridge to keep out of children's reach, and place the snack(s) on lower shelves for easy access.
CreateChildFriendlyFridge.name: CreateChildFriendlyFridge

CupcakeCleanup.description: Move the fresh-baked cupcake off the tray onto the counter, and place the bowl used for mixing into the sink.
CupcakeCleanup.name: CupcakeCleanup

CutBuffetPizza.description: Take the pizza cutter from the drawer on the *left/right* and place it on the dining counter for cutting.
CutBuffetPizza.name: CutBuffetPizza

CuttingToolSelection.description: Place the appropriate cutting tool for cutting the [*fruit/vegetable*] skin on the cutting board.
CuttingToolSelection.name: CuttingToolSelection

DateNight.description: Get the [*decoration*] and the [*alcohol*] from the cabinet and move them to the dining counter.
DateNight.name: DateNight

DefrostByCategory.description: There is a mixed pile of frozen fruits and vegetables on the counter. Locate all the frozen vegetables and place the items in a bowl on the counter. Take all the frozen fruits and defrost them in a running sink.
DefrostByCategory.name: DefrostByCategory

DeliverBrewedCoffee.description: Pick up the brewed coffee from the coffee machine and place it next to the breakfast plate on the dining counter.
DeliverBrewedCoffee.name: DeliverBrewedCoffee

DeliverStraw.description: Take a straw from the drawer in front and place it inside the glass cup on the dining counter.
DeliverStraw.name: DeliverStraw

DessertAssembly.description: Place the [*container*] with [*dessert*] and the cupcake onto the tray.
DessertAssembly.name: DessertAssembly

DessertUpgrade.description: Move the dessert items from the plates to the tray.
DessertUpgrade.name: DessertUpgrade

DisplayMeatVariety.description: Retrieve the chicken, shrimp, and steak from the fridge and place them on the serving tray on the dining counter.
DisplayMeatVariety.name: DisplayMeatVariety

DistributeChicken.description: Take the chicken drumsticks from the pan and place one on each plate on the dining counter.
DistributeChicken.name: DistributeChicken

DistributeSteakOnPans.description: Turn on the stove burner for the empty pan. Then move one steak from the full pan to the empty pan to achieve better heat distribution and more room for maneuverability.
DistributeSteakOnPans.name: DistributeSteakOnPans

DivideBasins.description: Move any existing items from the left basin to the right basin for drying. Then move the [*washing item*] from the counter to the left basin of the sink for washing.
DivideBasins.name: DivideBasins

DivideBuffetTrays.description: Gather the [*vegetables*] from the fridge and place them on a tray on the dining counter. Then gather the [*meats*] from the fridge and place them on the other tray.
DivideBuffetTrays.name: DivideBuffetTrays

DrainVeggies.description: Dump the [*vegetable*] from the pot into the sink. Then turn on the water and wash the [*vegetable*]. Then turn off the water and put the [*vegetable*] back in the pot.
DrainVeggies.name: DrainVeggies

DrawerUtensilSort.description: Open the *left/right* drawer and place the utensils inside it.
DrawerUtensilSort.name: DrawerUtensilSort

DrinkwareConsolidation.description: Pick the [*drinkware*] from the counter and place them in the open cabinet.
DrinkwareConsolidation.name: DrinkwareConsolidation

DryDishes.description: Pick the cup and bowl from the sink and place them on the counter for drying.
DryDishes.name: DryDishes

DryDrinkware.description: Pick up the mug and place it upside down in the open cabinet.
DryDrinkware.name: DryDrinkware

DumpLeftovers.description: Dump the [*leftovers*] from the bowl so the bowl can be washed. Place the bowl in the sink after clearing the leftovers.
DumpLeftovers.name: DumpLeftovers

EmptyDishRack.description: Pick up the mug from the dish rack and place it inside the open cabinet where all mugs go. Then close the cabinet door(s).
EmptyDishRack.name: EmptyDishRack

FillBlenderJug.description: Turn on the sink faucet and place the jug under the water for a few seconds to fill it up.
FillBlenderJug.name: FillBlenderJug

FillKettle.description: Open the cabinet, pick the kettle from the cabinet, and place it in the sink.
FillKettle.name: FillKettle

FilterMicrowavableItem.description: Remove the [*fruit*] from the bowl and place it on the small plate. Then place the bowl with only the [*meat*] in the microwave, close the door, and press the start button to microwave the [*meat*].
FilterMicrowavableItem.name: FilterMicrowavableItem

FoodCleanup.description: Pick the [*food items*] from the counter and place them in the cabinet. Then close the cabinet.
FoodCleanup.name: FoodCleanup

FreezeBottledWaters.description: Take the bottled waters from the counter and place them in the freezer to freeze. Close the freezer door after placing the bottles.
FreezeBottledWaters.name: FreezeBottledWaters

FreezeCookedFood.description: Store the [*food*] in the freezer for long-term storage. Close the freezer door after placing the cooked food.
FreezeCookedFood.name: FreezeCookedFood

FreezeIceTray.description: The ice cube tray has been filled with water. Take the tray and place it in the freezer to make ice. Close the freezer door after placing the tray.
FreezeIceTray.name: FreezeIceTray

FreshProduceOrganization.description: Place the [*fruit/vegetable*] in the correct fridge rack based on whether it is a fruit or vegetable. Finally, close the fridge door.
FreshProduceOrganization.name: FreshProduceOrganization

FryingPanAdjustment.description: Pick and place the pan from the current burner to another burner and turn the burner on.
FryingPanAdjustment.name: FryingPanAdjustment

GarnishCake.description: Place one cherry either on top of the cake or on the cake plate, next to the cake. Then place one strawberry on the cake plate, next to the cake.
GarnishCake.name: GarnishCake

GarnishCupcake.description: Take the cinnamon bottle from the cabinet and place it on the dining table, next to the plate with the cupcake. Then take the chocolate from the dining counter and place it on the cupcake plate.
GarnishCupcake.name: GarnishCupcake

GarnishPancake.description: Take the strawberry from the fridge and place it on top of the pancake, located on the dining counter.
GarnishPancake.name: GarnishPancake

GatherCuttingTools.description: Open the drawer on the *left/right* and place the cutting tools on the cutting board.
GatherCuttingTools.name: GatherCuttingTools

GatherMarinadeIngredients.description: Retrieve the bottle and the shaker from the cabinet and place them next to the mixing bowl on the counter. Then add garlic from the fridge to the mixing bowl.
GatherMarinadeIngredients.name: GatherMarinadeIngredients

GatherProduceWashing.description: Pick up the [*foods*] from the fridge and place them in the bowl next to the sink.
GatherProduceWashing.name: GatherProduceWashing

GatherTableware.description: Gather all objects into one cabinet and sort the glasses and bowls to opposite sides.
GatherTableware.name: GatherTableware

GatherVegetables.description: Pick up [*vegetables*] from the sink and place them on the cutting board on the counter.
GatherVegetables.name: GatherVegetables

GetToastedBread.description: Start the toaster. Once the lever pops up, take the bread to the plate on the dining counter.
GetToastedBread.name: GetToastedBread

HeatKebabSandwich.description: Pick up the kebab skewer and baguette bread, and place them inside the toaster oven. Close the toaster oven door and start by setting the timer.
HeatKebabSandwich.name: HeatKebabSandwich

HeatMug.description: Pick the mug from the counter and place it inside the microwave. Then close the microwave.
HeatMug.name: HeatMug

HeatMultipleWater.description: Pick the kettle from the cabinet and place it on a stove burner. Then pick the pot from the counter and place it on another stove burner. Finally, turn both burners on.
HeatMultipleWater.name: HeatMultipleWater

HotDogSetup.description: Move the hot dog bun to the plate on the dining table and place the [*condiment*] next to that plate. Then navigate to the fridge and take the sausage and place it on the plate as well.
HotDogSetup.name: HotDogSetup

JuiceFruitReamer.description: Juice the [*fruit*] by pressing it against the reamer.
JuiceFruitReamer.name: JuiceFruitReamer

KettleBoiling.description: Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on a stove burner. Then turn the burner on.
KettleBoiling.name: KettleBoiling

LemonSeasoningFish.description: Retrieve a lemon from the fridge and place it on the cutting board with the fish.
LemonSeasoningFish.name: LemonSeasoningFish

LineUpCondiments.description: Take two condiments from the cabinet and move them on the counter near the stove. Make sure the condiments are lined up with each other, next to each other.
LineUpCondiments.name: LineUpCondiments

LoadCondimentsInFridge.description: Place the [*condiments*] from the counter to the top shelf of the fridge. If the existing items in the fridge are on the top shelf, move them to other shelves.
LoadCondimentsInFridge.name: LoadCondimentsInFridge

LoadDishwasher.description: Pick up the [*dishes*] from the counter, place them in the dishwasher, and close the dishwasher door.
LoadDishwasher.name: LoadDishwasher

LoadFridgeByType.description: Place the bowl with the [*vegetable*] on the *top/second highest* shelf of the fridge. Place the bowl with the [*meat*] on the *second highest/top* highest shelf of the fridge.
LoadFridgeByType.name: LoadFridgeByType

LoadFridgeFifo.description: Place the [*meat*] on the counter behind the older [*meat*] on the same shelf of the fridge to maintain FIFO order. Close the fridge door when finished.
LoadFridgeFifo.name: LoadFridgeFifo

LoadPreparedFood.description: Place the tupperware on the *top/second highest* shelf of the fridge. Make space for the tupperware among the existing items by rearranging them on the shelves if needed. Close the fridge door when finished.
LoadPreparedFood.name: LoadPreparedFood

LowerHeat.description: Lower the heat of the kettle.
LowerHeat.name: LowerHeat

MakeBananaMilkshake.description: Grab the honey bottle and place it next to the blender. Then grab the milk and banana from the fridge, and place the milk next to the blender while placing the banana in the blender jug to prepare making a banana milkshake.
MakeBananaMilkshake.name: MakeBananaMilkshake

MakeCheesecakeFilling.description: Add the butter stick, sugar cube, and cream cheese stick to the stand mixer bowl and then turn the speed knob to begin making cheesecake filling.
MakeCheesecakeFilling.name: MakeCheesecakeFilling

MakeChocolateMilk.description: Place one chocolate piece and one sugar cube in the warm glass of milk to make chocolate flavored milk.
MakeChocolateMilk.name: MakeChocolateMilk

MakeFruitBowl.description: Open the cabinet. Pick the [*fruits*] from the cabinet and place them into the bowl. Then close the cabinet.
MakeFruitBowl.name: MakeFruitBowl

MakeIceLemonade.description: Grab a lemon wedge from the fridge and one ice cube from the ice bowl, and put them in the glass of lemonade.
MakeIceLemonade.name: MakeIceLemonade

MakeIcedCoffee.description: Pick up an ice cube and place it in the glass of coffee.
MakeIcedCoffee.name: MakeIcedCoffee

MakeLoadedPotato.description: Retrieve the reheated potato from the microwave, then place the potato, cheese, and condiment on the cutting board.
MakeLoadedPotato.name: MakeLoadedPotato

MatchCupAndDrink.description: There is a wine glass and glass cup on the dining counter. Place the wine bottle next to the wine glass and the juice bottle next to the glass cup.
MatchCupAndDrink.name: MatchCupAndDrink

MaximizeFreezerSpace.description: Take the [*source items*] from the *highest/second highest* rack and move them to the *second highest/highest* rack where the [*target items*] are located, to maximize freezer space. Close the freezer door after rearranging.
MaximizeFreezerSpace.name: MaximizeFreezerSpace

MealPrepStaging.description: Place both pans onto different burners. Then place the [*vegetable*] and the [*meat*] on different pans.
MealPrepStaging.name: MealPrepStaging

MeatSkewerAssembly.description: Move the kebab skewers from the plate to the oven tray for oven preparation.
MeatSkewerAssembly.name: MeatSkewerAssembly

MeatTransfer.description: Retrieve the [*container*] from the cabinet, then place the raw meat into the [*container*] to avoid contamination.
MeatTransfer.name: MeatTransfer

MicrowaveCorrectMeal.description: Place the bowl containing the [*food*] in the microwave. Close the microwave door and press the start button to microwave the meal.
MicrowaveCorrectMeal.name: MicrowaveCorrectMeal

MicrowaveDefrostMeat.description: Place the tupperware containing the frozen [*meat*] in the microwave. Close the microwave door and press the start button to defrost the meat.
MicrowaveDefrostMeat.name: MicrowaveDefrostMeat

MicrowaveThawing.description: Pick the [*food*] from the counter and place it in the microwave. Then turn on the microwave.
MicrowaveThawing.name: MicrowaveThawing

MicrowaveThawingFridge.description: Transport the [*meat*] from the fridge to the microwave and turn on the microwave.
MicrowaveThawingFridge.name: MicrowaveThawingFridge

MixCakeFrosting.description: Add butter and sugar cubes to the stand mixer bowl and then turn on the stand mixer to begin making frosting.
MixCakeFrosting.name: MixCakeFrosting

MixedFruitPlatter.description: Pick up the [*fruit items*] from the fridge and place one fruit on each plate on the dining counter.
MixedFruitPlatter.name: MixedFruitPlatter

MoveFreezerToFridge.description: Pick up the frozen [*meat*] from the freezer, place it on any shelf in the fridge, and close the fridge and freezer doors when done.
MoveFreezerToFridge.name: MoveFreezerToFridge

MoveFridgeToFreezer.description: There's a [*meat*] in the fridge that needs to be moved to the freezer for freezing. Pick up the [*meat*] from the fridge, place it on any shelf in the freezer, and close the fridge and freezer doors when done.
MoveFridgeToFreezer.name: MoveFridgeToFreezer

MoveToCounter.description: Pick the [*frosted item*] from the fridge and place it on the plate on the counter.
MoveToCounter.name: MoveToCounter

MoveToFreezerDrawer.description: Take the [*food items*] from the fridge shelf and place them in the freezer drawer to begin freezing them.
MoveToFreezerDrawer.name: MoveToFreezerDrawer

MultistepSteaming.description: Turn on the sink faucet. Then move the [*vegetable*] from the counter to the sink. Turn off the sink. Move the vegetable from the sink to the pot next to the stove. Finally move the pot to the [*burner location*] burner.
MultistepSteaming.name: MultistepSteaming

OpenBlenderLid.description: Open the blender by taking off the lid and placing it on the counter.
OpenBlenderLid.name: OpenBlenderLid

OpenElectricKettleLid.description: Press the button to open the lid of the electric kettle.
OpenElectricKettleLid.name: OpenElectricKettleLid

OrganizeBakingIngredients.description: Gather the eggs and milk located in the vicinity of the sink area and place them right next to the bowl.
OrganizeBakingIngredients.name: OrganizeBakingIngredients

OrganizeCleaningSupplies.description: Open the cabinet. Pick the [*cleaning supply*] and place it next to the sink. Then close the cabinet.
OrganizeCleaningSupplies.name: OrganizeCleaningSupplies

OrganizeCoffeeCondiments.description: Pick the *syrup bottle/cinnamon* and honey bottle from the cabinet and place them next to the mug.
OrganizeCoffeeCondiments.name: OrganizeCoffeeCondiments

OrganizeCondiments.description: There are various items on the counter. Only move the condiments/shakers into the cabinet.
OrganizeCondiments.name: OrganizeCondiments

OrganizeMeasuringCups.description: Organize the measuring cups left to right, smallest to largest. The measuring cups must be rotated so the handle points directly outward towards the front of the counter. Make sure the measuring cups are upright.
OrganizeMeasuringCups.name: OrganizeMeasuringCups

OrganizeMetallicUtensils.description: Pick up the metallic utensils from the counter and place them in the open drawer. Make sure not to pick up any wooden utensils.
OrganizeMetallicUtensils.name: OrganizeMetallicUtensils

OrganizeMugsByHandle.description: Pick the mug on the counter and place it in the cabinet with the handle facing the right, like the mugs already inside.
OrganizeMugsByHandle.name: OrganizeMugsByHandle

OrganizeVegetables.description: Place the [*vegetable1*] and the [*vegetable2*] on separate cutting boards.
OrganizeVegetables.name: OrganizeVegetables

TurnOffMicrowave.description: Press the stop button on the microwave.
TurnOffMicrowave.name: TurnOffMicrowave

TurnOffSimmeredSauceHeat.description: Wait until the marinara sauce is simmered to a deep red color and then turn off the stove.
TurnOffSimmeredSauceHeat.name: TurnOffSimmeredSauceHeat

TurnOffStove.description: Turn off the [burner location] burner of the stove.
TurnOffStove.name: TurnOffStove

TurnOnBlender.description: Turn on the blender by pressing the power button.
TurnOnBlender.name: TurnOnBlender

TurnOnElectricKettle.description: Press down the lever to turn on the electric kettle.
TurnOnElectricKettle.name: TurnOnElectricKettle

TurnOnMicrowave.description: Press the start button on the microwave.
TurnOnMicrowave.name: TurnOnMicrowave

TurnOnStove.description: Turn on the [burner location] burner of the stove.
TurnOnStove.name: TurnOnStove

TurnOnToaster.description: Push down the lever of the toaster to turn it on.
TurnOnToaster.name: TurnOnToaster

TurnOnToasterOven.description: Turn on the toaster oven by setting the timer.
TurnOnToasterOven.name: TurnOnToasterOven

TurnSinkSpout.description: Turn the sink spout to the {left/right}.
TurnSinkSpout.name: TurnSinkSpout

UtensilShuffle.description: Pick and place the utensils into the open drawer.
UtensilShuffle.name: UtensilShuffle

VeggieDipPrep.description: Place the two vegetables and bowl onto the tray for setting up a vegetable dip station.
VeggieDipPrep.name: VeggieDipPrep

WaffleReheat.description: Open the microwave, place the bowl with waffle inside the microwave, then close the microwave door and turn it on.
WaffleReheat.name: WaffleReheat

WarmCroissant.description: Pick the croissant and place it on the pan. Then turn on the stove to warm the croissant.
WarmCroissant.name: WarmCroissant

WashFish.description: Take the fish out of the fridge, briefly rinse it in the sink, and place it on the tray next to the sink.
WashFish.name: WashFish

WashFruitColander.description: Put the colander in the sink, put the [*fruit*] in the colander, and turn on the sink faucet and pour water over the colander.
WashFruitColander.name: WashFruitColander

WashInSaucepan.description: Pick up the [*vegetables*] from the fridge and place them in the saucepan with water next to the sink for soak washing.
WashInSaucepan.name: WashInSaucepan

WashLettuce.description: Wash the lettuce in the sink by running water over it.
WashLettuce.name: WashLettuce

WeighIngredients.description: Pick the [*packaged food*] and place it on the digital scale for weighing, and close the cabinet.
WeighIngredients.name: WeighIngredients

WipeTable.description: Pick up the sponge from the counter and wipe the counter by gripping it and pressing it against the surface. Once finished, release the sponge.
WipeTable.name: WipeTable

YogurtDelightPrep.description: Place the yogurt and fruit(s) onto the counter.
YogurtDelightPrep.name: YogurtDelightPrep
